messages:
Alex Chen: hey all, first day here! quick cloud access q — trying to set up a small onboarding env. Need access to a GCP project (redwood-dev-alex) + billing link so I can create VMs, and AWS assume-role access for the usual dev account. Tried the self-serve but the billing form errors out on the Billing Account ID. any tips? :wave:
Samir Patel: welcome Alex :wave: For GCP billing attach we need the billing account ID formatted like `012345-678901-234567`. If the form errors, paste the ID here and I can attach it manually and open the project for you. Also include the project id you want created (suggest `redwood-dev-alex`).
Alex Chen: thanks Samir — billing id I pasted was `012345-678901-234567`. yes please create `redwood-dev-alex`. I need these roles: `roles/viewer`, `roles/iam.serviceAccountUser`, and `roles/billing.user`. Also need KMS encrypt/decrypt on the dev key if possible.
Marta Gomez: Hi Alex — for AWS we use cross-account assume roles. I can add you to the dev-role: `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Dev-Role`. Send me the email you used for AWS console access and I’ll grant the `sts:AssumeRole` trust. Note region constraints: by default dev accounts allow `us-west-2` and `eu-west-1`; for `ap-southeast-1`/APAC you need to file a region enable ticket to cloud-compliance.
Alex Chen: my AWS email is alex.chen@redwood.ai. And for KMS, the key is `projects/redwood-dev-123/locations/global/keyRings/dev-kr/cryptoKeys/dev-key` — is that right?
Samir Patel: got it. I'll attach billing to the project and add the IAM roles. For KMS, I need to add you to group `redwood-dev-kms` which has `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter`. Once I add you the CLI command to test will be:
```
gcloud kms decrypt --project=redwood-dev-alex --location=global --keyring=dev-kr --key=dev-key --ciphertext-file=ciphertext.bin --plaintext-file=plaintext.bin
```
Samir Patel: also creating a ticket now to track this: INC-2345 (infra) and tagging @marta for the AWS role.
infra-bot: ticket INC-2345 created by samir for redwood-dev-alex access. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2345
deploy-bot: note: provisioning of project may take ~15-30m after billing attach.
Marta Gomez: I sent the assume-role invite to alex.chen@redwood.ai. Once you accept, you can do `aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Dev-Role --role-session-name onboarding` and then export the temporary creds.
Alex Chen: awesome — see the invite, accepted. filing the cloud form now as well. If I hit any other perms errors I’ll reply here. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Samir Patel: welcome aboard — ping #eng-infra if anything blocks and we’ll escalate.
